facts.fact: CEMAC Regulation 01/20 of 3 July 2020 on consumer protection for banking products and services, with a Prime Minister's decree of 21 March 2024 and two ministerial arrets of 7 January 2025, sets the financial mediation framework, covering payment institutions and mobile money disputes.

note: The mediation launch was scheduled for 26 October 2026 (forward notice; mediator named by arrete in June 2026), so no redress fact is recorded.
